title: Ruby Civ
description: The Vanilla Compatible Civilization Server with a Great Community and less grinding! With admins who stay out of the way but still do a great job and fix problems fast, you can play uninterrupted! What will your story be?
body:
A long-term Bedrock x Java civilization server, with no lag and fair rules! 1.21.11 but cross compatable with other versions (even bedrock!) and you don't need any mods to be able to join! We welcome new members to come and see if this server is for them! You only live once, so you might as well join and check it out!

# Points of Strength
- fair moderation that doesn't interfere, but will absolutely ban people quickly if we have to
- no server lag at all! (you may still have client side lag, not much we can do about that)
- an amazing, welcoming community!
- easy to understand server-side mods that enhance gameplay!
(mods include vein-miner, and some extra crafting recipes that the server owner made!)

See #info in the discord for more information! [Join the Discord by Clicking Here!](https://discord.gg/FHdqQkD3Rm)
